towns.name: Nanto
towns.summary: Nanto, one of the nine original starter towns, flourished on the old southern border of the Sho realm and has settled into a slower life on the road between Hebian-To and the frontier; it is famous for its beautiful waterfalls. The town climbs a hillside in terraces (z 86-118) of green-roofed halls with a nullified reedshark statue, the Town Network portal and two octagon towers, one on the hilltop beside the Life Stone. To the west lie the Blue Ghost Falls, where the wizard Kushina Naidu slew a Gigas Lugian warlord: an upper cascade down a staircase of cliffs (z 178 to 120) into a pool beside a bamboo fishing hut ringed by four torches, and a second cascade into a lower pool (z 70) by Farmer Ar'Oyd's farm.
